title: Custom Party Commands
description: A mod that adds party commands that you can configure, inspired from skyblock QOL mods.
body:
[![Bisect partnership](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbcbb08e5b1f3eda79a564897c1a0cff2e08f731_0.webp)](https://url-shortener.curseforge.com/ukFY2)


Custom Party Commands adds the ability to create your own commands like the ones in Skyblock QOL Mods (!M7, !dt, etc...), works with any prefix on any server, not just hypixel.

Open the config screen by typing !config or /cpcconfig, configs are stored as JSON so if you want to import/export config to send to other players head over to .minecraft/config/custom_party_commands.json

![config screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9281a6548bd198189133bed2c61bdd95aa43b4d_0.webp)
